executive_message: 12 weeks before census, the institutional target is 840 students. Forecasts range from 757 to 824. The multivariable Ridge forecast is 824, while the deposit-based operational forecast is 757. The models differ by 68 students. Decision status: High model disagreement / downside exposure. Leadership should avoid relying on a single point forecast and investigate conversion behavior before making enrollment-dependent budget or staffing commitments.
